verdict.rationale: Steel's own docs include integrations that run OpenAI's vision-based computer-use agent loop on a Steel browser session, with matching guides for Claude and Gemini Computer Use. Steel also exposes a screenshots API. However, the vision model and agent loop come from third-party providers, and the evidence describes no Steel-native mode switch between DOM and screenshot actions. Missing for 10: a native, documented way to switch between DOM and vision/coordinate action modes within Steel; detail on screenshot-based actions (click/type at coordinates) for canvases; independent or hands-on corroboration.
